hypothesis: Directly conjugating canonical ProtoMotions joint rotations by the cached Manny parent action axis in world space causes the non-identity excess in the live action-to-observation round-trip errors; expressing that same cached axis in mesh component space will make every actual-action and known-axis round-trip error equal the joint's unchanged identity residual while the captured policy neutral remains fixed.
supporting_runtime_evidence: E15's behavior-neutral trace established a constant 90-degree mesh-component-to-world rotation for all 21 controls in the locked harness.

E15 established that action and observation bind parent-relative rotations match exactly and that the cached action axis matches the observation parent bind after explicit world-to-component conversion.
E15 identity inputs, which are invariant to conjugation axis, failed on all 19 decisive joints by 0.104936 to 35.962549 degrees, exactly localizing a separate policy-neutral-versus-bind residual.
E15 nonzero inputs exceeded those identity residuals: all 19 actual targets failed with a maximum 106.601652-degree error and all 114 axis probes failed with a maximum 47.155156-degree error.
E15 trace-off and trace-on physics, policy, inputs, action semantics, render, locked failures, and behavioral metrics were exact, so these frame measurements are behavior-neutral runtime evidence.
competing_explanations: Canonical decoded joint rotations are intentionally world-frame quantities, so world-space action-axis conjugation is correct and component conversion will not collapse the nonzero-input excess.
The excess comes from quaternion multiplication direction/order rather than the world/component axis choice.
The E15 component-to-world relationship is measured correctly but another unobserved target frame between composition and observation recovery causes the excess.

expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The baseline reproduces E15. The experimental trace confirms component-space axis selection; every decisive identity input and identity round-trip error is unchanged from baseline within 0.001 degrees; and for each of 19 decisive joints the experimental actual-action error and each of six XYZ-probe errors equal that same joint's experimental identity residual within 0.001 degrees. Physical metrics are reported without being part of semantic support.
falsification_observation: The experimental trace confirms component-space axis selection, but any decisive identity result changes beyond 0.001 degrees or any decisive actual-action/axis-probe error differs from its joint's unchanged identity residual by more than 0.001 degrees.

instrumentation_before_behavior.plan: Extend the development-only local-frame trace/evaluator first so it publishes configured/effective axis mode, cached world axis, component-corrected axis, effective axis, actual runtime pre-range target, and per-case results using the effective axis. Commit this instrumentation before the override behavior commit.
instrumentation_before_behavior.historical_compatibility: The evaluator must continue to evaluate E15 v1 artifacts or retain the E15 evaluator behavior unchanged while adding an E16 schema/evaluator path.

invalid_run_conditions: The instrumentation and behavior are not separated into ordered commits before runtime execution.
The two arms do not use one clean behavior commit and one reused binary.
Seed, timestep, initial pose, perturbation, capture window, model, protocol, evaluator, or thresholds differ.
The baseline does not reproduce E15's first-policy input, active-standing input, action semantic trace, physics, policy, render, failed criteria, and key behavioral metrics.
First-policy input, first-active-standing input, decoded first-active action, or any other pre-composition value differs between arms.
The baseline trace does not identify world-axis mode or the experimental trace does not identify component-axis mode.
Either trace lacks 21 complete controls, 19 decisive one-to-one controls, 152 decisive cases, finite normalized frames, actual runtime pre-range targets, or successful publication/readback.
The evaluator, trace, manifest, or any required raw artifact is malformed or missing.

locked_judges.support_rule: All validity and pre-intervention equivalence gates pass; identity inputs/targets/errors remain unchanged within 0.001 degrees; and all 19 actual-action plus all 114 axis-probe experimental errors equal their joint's unchanged identity residual within 0.001 degrees.
locked_judges.falsification_rule: Validity and component-axis selection are confirmed, but identity changes or at least one actual/probe error fails equality with its unchanged joint identity residual at 0.001 degrees.

implementation_constraints: Add no production default, activation-contract, persistent settings, serialization, locked protocol, threshold, neutral, constraint, physics, or target-publication change.
The experimental override must be impossible outside WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS and omitted by default.
Instrumentation must observe the actual effective runtime axis and target rather than infer the selected path from the command line alone.

The evaluator must independently recompute quaternion composition/recovery and reject missing, non-finite, non-normalized, duplicate, ownership-inconsistent, wrong-mode, or pre-intervention-mismatched artifacts.
Tests must validate invariants, frame ownership, mode selection, historical compatibility, malformed-input rejection, and metric publication rather than endorsing a candidate production constant.
Run a fresh unchanged baseline beside the experiment using one clean behavior commit and reused binary, record the result, then stop before neutral substitution or production promotion.

next_step_rules.if_supported: Remove or retain the axis override according to evidence, then preregister a separate one-variable neutral-versus-bind experiment; do not promote either change in the E16 evidence commit.
next_step_rules.if_falsified: Remove the rejected axis behavior and select the highest-information multiplication-order or hidden-frame diagnostic; do not layer neutral substitution on top.
